adjudication.rationale: The diff removes usernames-from-create support: `Discourse.Group#create()` now POSTs only `{name, alias_level, visible}` (no usernames) and `Admin::GroupsController#create` now reads `params[:name]`/`params[:visible]` only, whereas the previous implementation accepted `params[:group][:usernames]`. Membership changes are now handled via new `PUT /admin/groups/:group_id/members` (`add_members`) after the group has an id (UI shows add-members only under `{{#if id}}`). So “membership-at-create via POST /admin/groups is no longer possible” is correct, but it’s an intentional API/behavior change rather than a verifiable defect from the diff alone.
